name: Release v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(tree): skip windows that close during a capture instead of retrying them by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/609
* fix(screenshot): add the capture origin to the image-to-screen conversion by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/613
* fix(input): check that every MultiEdit text is a string before typing by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/612
* fix(tree): sleep each window retry delay once instead of twice by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/610
* chore(deps): bump joserfc from 1.7.5 to 1.7.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/611
* chore(deps): bump the all-dependencies group across 1 directory with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/604
* fix(cli): ignore case in --exclude-tools and --tools, reject unknown names by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/617
* chore(deps): bump opentelemetry-api from 1.45.1 to 1.45.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/621
* chore(deps): bump dnspython from 2.9.0 to 2.9.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/620
* chore(deps): bump the all-dependencies group with 3 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/619
* chore(deps): bump soupsieve from 2.10 to 4.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/618
* fix(snapshot): escape line breaks in UI tree names and values by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/615
* fix(snapshot): stop listing edit fields scrolled out of view at (0,0) by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/616
* fix(snapshot): list a browser's own controls in the UI tree by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/614
* fix(snapshot): reject booleans as display indices by @CJstate in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/625
* fix(tools): keep readable stderr lines preceding CLIXML output by @CJstate in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/624
* fix(desktop): keep borderless and custom-frame windows in get_windows (#623) by @kings-avathar54 in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/627
* fix(desktop): restore the indentation get_windows lost in #627 by @cyppe in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/630
* perf(control): stop polling while idle (idle CPU 3.4% → ~0.2%) by @HeeyunCho in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/628
* feat: fit the server to Claude Code and Claude Desktop by @HeeyunCho in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/629
* fix(screenshot): release the last screenshot and idle dxcam cameras by @HeeyunCho in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/633
* perf(flash): draw the capture glow as cached edge strips faded by constant alpha by @HeeyunCho in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/632
* fix(clipboard): retry OpenClipboard while another process holds the clipboard by @FaberVi in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/527
* fix(app): resize the window in front when App resize gets no name by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/634
* fix(snapshot): show each element's label in the UI tree by @tanishqbaweja in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/637

## New Contributors
* @CJstate made their first contribution in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/625
* @kings-avathar54 made their first contribution in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/627
* @HeeyunCho made their first contribution in https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/pull/628

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP/compare/v0.8.9...v0.9.0
